description: This file defines classes and structures related to association frame reassociation request fields, including classes for handling current AP address, fast BSS transition, FMS and DMS requests, with methods for parsing, serialization, and size management.

classes.name: cCurrentApAddress
classes.description: Represents the current access point address in association frames, with methods for parsing and serialization.

classes.name: cFastBssTrans
classes.description: Handles Fast BSS Transition element, including data management and serialization.

classes.name: cFmsRequest
classes.description: Represents FMS (Fast Transition Management System) request element with methods for handling sub-elements.

classes.name: cDmsRequest
classes.description: Represents DMS (Distributed Management System) request element with methods for handling description list.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the respective class object.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Performs byte order swapping for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the object after parsing or modification.
